# Oak Cherry Kraft

Welcome to Oak Cherry Kraft – Handcrafted furniture made in Nigeria, transforming premium and discarded wood into beautiful pieces designed to last.

## About Us

**Oak Cherry Kraft Artistry Limited**  
Bespoke furniture design and handcrafted commissions  
FHA Guzape, Abuja, Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria  
Shonibare Estate, Lagos State, Nigeria
[oakcherrykraft@gmail.com](mailto:oakcherrykraft@gmail.com)

## Quality Assurance

Every published design is made to order and can be tailored to your space. We specialize in:
- Premium hardwood furniture
- Bespoke commissions
- Custom dimensions and finishes
- Sustainable wood transformation
- Long-lasting luxury pieces

For inquiries about custom projects, bespoke commissions, or product information, please visit our contact page or email [oakcherrykraft@gmail.com](mailto:oakcherrykraft@gmail.com).
